quests.title: Anomaly: Mondstadt

dialogue.section: Check out the situation at Dragonspine

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME}, Paimon. I assume you're here for this?
Yeah... Looks like Dragonspine's Skyfrost Nail has changed in the exact same way.
In all my time on Dragonspine, this is the first time I've witnessed a phenomenon like this...
I always assumed that once the Heavenly Principles passed down their judgment, the Skyfrost Nail destroyed the ancient civilization here and its purpose was then complete.
But clearly, it's not quite as simple as that.
I'll remain here and continue my observations, focusing in particular on how this change is affecting the surrounding ecosystem.

quests.description: Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
